label: counts every subject again: a docs-only range forces a release
default back to 5: one user-visible merge no longer ships
test-file exclusion dropped: a test-only change counts as shipped work
pace release_min back to 5: the patrol disagrees with the gate's default
a gate HOLD no longer stops the release: the user-visible threshold holds nothing
old:
*)
      printf '%s\n' "$CHK"
      [ "$waits" -gt 0 ] && log "GATE_WAIT ended after ${waits} checks: $(printf '%s' "$CHK" | sed -n 's/^reason=//p')"
      die "release-check says HOLD (see above)"
new:
*)
      printf '%s\n' "$CHK"
      [ "$waits" -gt 0 ] && log "GATE_WAIT ended after ${waits} checks: $(printf '%s' "$CHK" | sed -n 's/^reason=//p')"
      exit 0
